tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List recent chat conversations. Returns chats sorted by last activity. Use the conversation ID from results with read_messages to read messages.

tools.name: get_conversation_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a chat conversation including its members, topic, creator, and creation time.

tools.name: create_chat
tools.description: Create a new chat conversation with one or more users. Pass user MRIs (e.g., "8:live:username") as members. The current user is added automatically.

tools.name: set_channel_topic
tools.description: Set or update the topic (title) of a Teams chat conversation.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a Teams chat conversation. Use the conversation ID from list_conversations or create_chat.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read messages from a chat conversation. Returns messages sorted by time (newest first). Use the conversation ID from list_conversations.

tools.name: edit_message
tools.description: Edit a message in a Teams chat conversation. Only messages sent by the current user can be edited.

tools.name: delete_message
tools.description: Delete a message from a Teams chat conversation. Only messages sent by the current user can be deleted.

tools.name: invite_to_channel
tools.description: Add a user to a Teams group chat by their MRI identifier (e.g., "8:live:username").

tools.name: remove_member
tools.description: Remove a user from a Teams group chat. Requires admin privileges in the chat.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's profile information including their MRI identifier and email address.
